note: Recordings in place of synthesised sounds. For any slot, list one or more recordings: { "file": "sfx/name.mp3", "start": seconds, "len": seconds, "gain": 1 }. start, len and gain are optional (whole file, gain 1). Several entries for one slot are picked at random. A slot with an empty list stays synthesised. Record close (5 to 15 m for weapons): the simulator adds the delay, the loss of highs and the level for distance itself, and the muffling inside the hull. Slots ending in _in are what is heard INSIDE the turret; _loop slots are continuous layers and must loop cleanly. See docs/ASSETS.md, 'Sound slots'.
